description: Send the same prompt to 2-5 different models at once and return every answer side by side, so you can compare them, check a claim, review code or a plan, or break a tie. Default models: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct, qwen/qwen3.8-27b.

max_tokens.description: Cap on the reply length in tokens (default 4096). Reasoning models spend some of these thinking.

models.description: Model IDs to ask (2-5). Pick different families for independent views.

prompt.description: The full prompt, with all the context the models need.

reasoning_effort.description: How hard a reasoning model should think. Ignored by models without reasoning. Omit for the model's default.

system.description: Optional system prompt for every model.

name: second_opinion
title: Second opinion from several models
